provenance.note: The overhead price c_o per program, distance and budget (Section 5.4). A cell's mean, a distance's mean and the all-pooled mean are taken only over the programs with at least 20 early commits there (the fit's own minimum), with equal program weights, and the support is counted from the programs kept. Fitted on one seed-1 V2*-Sd run per cell at d = 13, 17 and 21 with the price off and margin 0 (--wq C=32768,H=16384,e=32,f=1,b=4096), made with the compiled recovery-script library (--library sx) and two ordinary rounds per H round (--h-depth 2).
provenance.rule: c_o = A / S per program cell, one seed-1 V2*-Sd run each, price off, margin 0, the queue on (Section 5.4)
